title.en: Meta opens weights of 816B Muse Spark

summary.zh: Meta发布开源权重多模态模型Muse Spark Open，总参数8160亿、激活420亿，支持百万token上下文并可在Mac集群部署。
summary.en: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816B open-weight multimodal model with 42B active parameters, 1M-token context and Mac-cluster support.

title.zh: FTC就智能体事件向OpenAI和Anthropic发出正式问询
title.en: FTC sends formal demands to OpenAI and Anthropic

summary.zh: 美国FTC就智能体事件和安全做法向OpenAI、Anthropic发出正式要求；Anthropic向METR研究人员提供员工级访问权限。
summary.en: The FTC sent OpenAI and Anthropic formal demands over agent incidents; Anthropic gave METR researchers employee-level access.

title.zh: 美国俄勒冈州本德市小学枪击案致5死
title.en: Bend, Oregon elementary school shooting kills five

summary.zh: 俄勒冈州本德市一所小学发生枪击，造成包括3名儿童和1名教师在内的5人死亡。
summary.en: A shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon killed five people, including three children and a teacher.

title.zh: 特朗普排除对伊朗动用核打击
title.en: Trump rules out nuclear strikes on Iran

summary.zh: 特朗普表示不会对伊朗动用核武器；沙特领导的联军拦截无人机。
summary.en: Trump rejected nuclear strikes on Iran, while the Saudi-led coalition intercepted drones.

title.zh: 科技股持续抛售 纳指跌2.1%录得周跌

summary.zh: 10月16日纳指跌2.1%，标普500跌1.1%，两者周线下跌，道指周线上涨。
summary.en: On Oct. 16 the Nasdaq fell 2.1% and the S&P 500 1.1%, both posting weekly losses while the Dow gained for the week.

title.zh: IEA成员加快释放约1亿桶储备 美国延长卢克石油豁免
title.en: IEA members speed oil release; US extends Lukoil waiver

summary.zh: IEA成员国加快释放约1亿桶应急石油储备；美国将对卢克石油的制裁豁免延长至4月24日。
summary.en: IEA members accelerated release of about 100 million barrels of emergency stocks, and the US extended a Lukoil sanctions waiver to April 24.

title.zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察
title.en: Xi Jinping inspects Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia

summary.zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察，强调统筹高质量发展和高水平保护。
summary.en: Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, stressing coordinated high-quality development and protection.

title.zh: 李强主持国务院常务会议 听取“人工智能+”行动进展

summary.zh: 国务院常务会议听取“人工智能+”行动进展汇报，讨论教师法、价格法修订草案。
summary.en: A State Council executive meeting reviewed the AI Plus initiative and discussed revisions to the Teachers Law and Price Law.

title.zh: 我国规范养老服务价格
title.en: China moves to standardize elderly care pricing

summary.zh: 《新闻联播》报道，我国出台规范养老服务价格的举措。
summary.en: CCTV reported new measures to standardize elderly care service pricing.
